title_en: Chinese Science Fiction (20/20): A Message Capsule for the Future
note_en: Look at 只要……就…… in 只要还有人愿意讲述和倾听，人类的故事就永远不会真正结束 "as long as someone is willing to tell and to listen, the human story will never truly end." 只要 introduces the condition and 就 must come before the verb of the result clause, so Chinese marks both halves, while English uses just "as long as." Compare 除了……还…… in S4: 除了科学知识，还放进了… "besides scientific knowledge, it also held…," where 还 again sits right before the verb.
